en-US.name: Sahayak Home & Civic Assistant
en-US.shortDescription: Shared grocery lists, household chores, language practice, transit, and mandi rates.
en-US.fullDescription: Sahayak Home simplifies household management, language learning, and civic inquiries. Maintain shared grocery lists and rotating chore assignments, get zero-waste pantry recipes, learn daily vocabulary with spaced repetition, practice spoken conversation in Spanish or Hindi, check live metro train departures, and verify mandi crop prices.
examplePhrases: Add milk to the grocery list.
Whose turn is it to take out the trash?
What can I cook with potatoes and onions?
Give me the word of the day in Spanish.
When is the next train from Rajiv Chowk?
What is the wheat price in Azadpur mandi?
